_comment: A source archive that carries everything in a directory of its own, which is the shape a repository download produces - so --sca-root is handed the folder ABOVE the build files, and --sca-source names that directory. Nobody who names the root has looked inside the archive yet, so the review settles which folder IS the root before it reads one (src/addon/sca-root.js): the lone subfolder holding a package.json becomes it, and --sca-source, being that same directory, keys as the flat root. What proves the correction happened is WHICH finding this produces. Uncorrected, the root holds no manifest and sca-package-file-missing rejects the submission as having no build at all. Corrected, the manifest is read where it lies, declares a range, commits no lock, and sca-lock-file-missing says so - the fault the submission actually has.
